_comment: Live GCI — proactive AWACS-style callouts over SRS, addressed by flight callsign. Copy this file to gci.json next to bfdb.exe (the path bfsystem.ps1's $gciConfigPath points at), fill in your values, and restart bfdb. Delete/rename gci.json to disable GCI.
_requires_engine: bfdb must run with --base (a live engine to query) — see $netidxBase in bfsystem.ps1.
_requires_srs: bfdb opens TWO persistent SRS connections (blue + red) and stays in the client list. It needs opus.dll — set opusDllPath to the one in your DCS-SimpleRadio-Standalone folder (e.g. C:\Program Files\DCS-SimpleRadio-Standalone\opus.dll), or copy that file next to bfdb.exe and leave opusDllPath blank.
_requires_eam: On a server with External AWACS Mode, set blueEamPassword / redEamPassword to the coalition passwords (EXTERNAL_AWACS_MODE_BLUE_PASSWORD / _RED_PASSWORD in your SRS server.cfg). Leave blank if the server does not require EAM auth.
_players: Each player controls their own calls in-game: -gci on|off|metric|imperial|auto (chat), or F10 -> EWR -> GCI Voice.
_slot_briefing: To show players the GCI frequency when they take a slot, set `gci_briefing` in the MISSION config (ODFv2_CFG / the bfweb Config Editor -> SAM Sites & Air Defense), NOT here: { "blue_freq": "251.0 AM", "red_freq": "252.0 AM", "note": "Broadcast only, no check-in needed" }. bflib does not read this file.
_bullseye_note: Spoken name for the bullseye reference point. Leave blank for the literal word 'bullseye'; set a mission codeword (e.g. 'WHISKEY') to have GCI use it in bullseye/faded/picture calls.
_voice_note: Leave piperExe blank to use Windows SAPI. Set piperExe + a per-side model for a Piper neural voice. bluePiperModel / redPiperModel let each side sound different (e.g. point redPiperModel at a Russian-accent en model). piperModel / ttsVoice are the shared fallback. blueTtsVoice / redTtsVoice pick named SAPI voices per side when Piper isn't set.
_stt_note: Speech recognition — players key up on the GCI freq and ask (BOGEY DOPE / PICTURE / DECLARE / SNAPLOCK / ALPHA CHECK / RADIO CHECK / COMMIT). Set whisperExe to whisper-cli.exe (or main.exe) from a whisper.cpp release, and whisperModel to a ggml model (ggml-base.en.bin is a good start). Leave blank to disable — GCI stays broadcast-only. They must name the controller: 'Magic, bogey dope'.
_transcript_note: discordWebhookUrl: paste a channel webhook (Channel Settings -> Integrations -> Webhooks -> New Webhook -> Copy URL) to also post every GCI call there as text. Leave blank to disable.
_units_note: Default spoken units when a player hasn't chosen: imperial (nm/kft) or metric (km/m).
_ref_note: Default position reference: braa (from the player's jet), bullseye, or clock. Players override with -gci braa|bulls|clock.
_gap_note: interCallGapSecs: quiet time on the freq between GCI transmissions so players can key up. GCI also listens before transmitting and waits for the channel to clear.
